title: Engineering Efficiency Platform | Ship Better Code Faster

hero.headline: Developer Productivity — improve engineering efficiency at scale
hero.subhead: Identify and remove friction from developer workflows so you can ship better code, faster.

sections.heading: How we help
sections.body: Reveal bottlenecks in tools/infra/collaboration; elevate code quality (coverage, flakiness, CFR, MTTR); create seamless workflows to avoid burnout.

sections.heading: Productivity
sections.body: Holistic metrics from leading frameworks; prebuilt dashboards for SPACE, DORA, DevEx; tailor metrics to goals and operating model.

sections.heading: DevEx Insights
sections.body: Corroborate team sentiment with engineering data; pre-built survey templates and administration; triangulated analysis of surveys with metrics; auto-generated recommendations.

sections.heading: Benchmarks
sections.body: Baseline performance, identify high-impact improvements; scorecards and heatmaps; root cause with trained AI.

sections.heading: Automation
sections.body: Prebuilt or custom automations for notifications, reminders, alerts; reminders for overdue reviews; alerts on declining developer focus time.

sections.heading: AI Assistant
sections.body: Ask Faros in Slack, Teams, or IDE: PR/task/repo answers for devs, team health for managers, progress-to-goal for leaders.

sections.heading: Coverage highlights
sections.body: Velocity (lead time, cycle times, review patterns), Quality (coverage, code smells, flakiness, CFR, MTTR), Releases (build volumes, deployment frequency), Developer Experience (surveys, telemetry correlation).

notes: This is the foundational analytics/observability surface — DORA/SPACE/DevEx metrics, surveys, benchmarks. Reads clearly as shipped. Closest to the seed tree's Observe pillar in spirit (joining engineering data) though framed for traditional dev-productivity rather than AI-token attribution. Testimonial: Ben Cochran, VP of Engineering, Autodesk. Note an internal staging URL leaked in body (farosai.webflow.io) — ignored, not a real public link.
